items.title: Brandon Aiyuk cleared waivers on Tuesday, making him a free agent.
items.text: Nobody claimed his 49ers contract. Our next blurb on Aiyuk will probably read something like “Commanders signed WR Brandon Aiyuk,” but until then we’re legally obligated to note that Adam Schefter reported he is expected to draw interest from “a few teams.” - Rivers McCown

items.title: Bears claimed CB Isaac Yiadom off waivers from the Commanders.
items.text: Yiadom has been a decent depth corner for most of the last half-decade, but only played on special teams with the Commanders this year. Perhaps the Bears see more in him, or perhaps they just need a gunner. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Broncos coach Sean Payton said he suspended J.K. Dobbins one game for conduct detrimental to the team.
items.text: For those of you who haven’t had the pleasure of rostering Dobbins anywhere, know that he played just one snap on Sunday. Whatever went down almost certainly has something to do with that low snap count, though Payton wouldn’t get into it publicly with reporters. If Dobbins could agitate enough to get released, maybe we’d get somewhere in fantasy circles, but as it stands there’s no reason to hold him in shallow leagues. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Kenneth Walker (groin) was limited in Tuesday’s practice.
items.text: This is at least the start of a movement for Walker to be active for Thanksgiving’s game against the Bills, it’s his first practice since suffering the groin injury. His status on Wednesday will be one of the biggest fantasy storylines of the week as it also underscores whether Emmett Johnson will be an RB1 or a contingency FLEX play. It’s hard to read too much into this one way or another, with Andy Reid saying early today that Walker “feels good” probably the best bellwether we have at this point. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Jake Ferguson did not practice on Tuesday.
items.text: He will almost certainly miss the Thanksgiving game against the Eagles after two more missed practices. It is perhaps feasible he could return for Week 13, which would be his fourth week since suffering this new knee injury. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Ben Skowronek (calf) did not practice on Tuesday.
items.text: This could open up more snaps for Pittsburgh’s ancillary receivers even if Skowronek is no fantasy force. He played 10 and 17 snaps in his first two weeks back from the calf injury after he was active for Week 10. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Michael Pittman (foot) practiced in full on Tuesday.
items.text: Mike McCarthy has said he is “very confident” that Pittman will play in Week 12 and this listing does little to douse that. It’s hard to understand if Pittman’s return will actually make Aaron Rodgers target the middle of the field or not, but he would be a rough FLEX play either way in his first game off IR with all 32 teams playing in Week 12. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Colts signed QB Shane Buechele off the Bills’ practice squad.
items.text: Buechele got his first NFL experience last year in Week 18, at age 27, when he completed 7-of-14 passes for 88 yards in a game the Chiefs were (probably) looking to lose against the Raiders. He was sacked five times. These last six Colts games will feel like they take five months. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Ravens waived WR LaJohntay Wester.
items.text: Wester muffed two punts last week against the Panthers, which we’re told is “not a good way to keep your roster spot” when you are here to be the returner. The Ravens will shuffle the deck here. - Rivers McCown

items.title: Packers activated Micah Parsons (knee/PUP) off the physically unable to perform list.
items.text: In other words, the questionable listing from an hour ago does not actually matter. Parsons is back after losing almost a year to a torn ACL. He’ll be directed to put some havoc on the field in his return against the Rams on Wednesday night. - Rivers McCown
